v0.2.7 Accounting

Filled vs. open: a report row with a volunteer/member is filled; a row without one is open. Quantity: myqty is counted as the number of positions represented by that row. Hours: when both timestamps are present, duration = (enddate - startdate) / 3600. Rows without an end timestamp are marked TBD.
